desc: Bloodshed no longer shocks you.  You have crossed a line and find the other side quieter than you expected.
Violence is becoming familiar.  The rush fades faster than it used to.
You have done this enough times that your hands do not tremble.
The work no longer touches you.  You feel the distance from a long way off.
You have seen too much to flinch.  Something in you has gone still.

desc: The violence unsettled you.  You keep seeing it when you close your eyes.
You cannot stop replaying it.  The memory intrudes at the worst moments.
The weight of what you have done is pressing on you.  You feel it in your chest.
You are coming apart at the edges.  Sleep brings no rest.
Something inside you has broken.  You are not sure it can be put back.
